2608.16373.title: OceanDepths: A Global Dataset of Paired Subsurface and Surface Ocean Observations
2608.16373.paper_summary: Despite comprising over 70\% of its surface, the world's oceans are critically underobserved compared to the land surface or the atmosphere.Understanding the global ocean requires jointly observing its surface and subsurface structure, yet no standardized, high-resolution dataset couples satellite surface fields to co-located \emph{in situ} depth profiles in an AI-ready format.Existing resources either consist of model-reconstructed gridded products rather than observations, cover only a single variable or basin, or operate at resolutions too coarse for mesoscale dynamics.We introduce \textsc{OceanDepths}, the first open, global, regridded AI-ready dataset that pairs satellite-derived sea surface temperature (SST), sea surface salinity (SSS), and sea surface height (SSH) L4 products with co-located EN4 subsurface temperature and salinity profiles, complemented by matched GLORYS12 ocean reanalysis data to support comparisons or multi-stage learning.The dataset spans 2000--2024 at \SI{0.1}{\degree}$\times$\SI{0.1}{\degree} spatial resolution and at weekly temporal resolution, covering the entire globe's sea surface and with over 9.5 million paired profiles interpolated to 50 standardized depth levels.We provide a configurable system to split the globe in equally sized spatial patches.The 4D multivariate structure, high resolution, long temporal extent, and extreme sparsity of subsurface observations (${\sim}$0.01\% per depth level) make \textsc{OceanDepths}a challenging testbed for novel AI methods.We demonstrate subsurface state reconstruction as an example task with simple baseline models, but also envision \textsc{OceanDepths}to support the development of observation-based forecast methods and other related tasks.\added{Available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ESA-philab/OceanDepths.}
2608.16373.paper_summary_zh: 儘管佔據了超過70\%的表面，世界的海洋與陸地表面或大氣相比，觀測仍然極為不足。理解全球海洋需要共同觀測其表面和次表面結構，但目前沒有標準化的高解析度數據集能夠將衛星表面場與共定位的\emph{in situ}深度剖面以AI準備格式結合。現有資源要麼是基於模型重建的網格產品，而非觀測數據，要麼僅涵蓋單一變量或流域，或者解析度過於粗糙，無法適應中尺度動力學。我們介紹\textsc{OceanDepths}，這是第一個開放的全球重網格AI準備數據集，將衛星衍生的海表溫度（SST）、海表鹽度（SSS）和海表高度（SSH）L4產品與共定位的EN4次表面溫度和鹽度剖面配對，並輔以匹配的GLORYS12海洋再分析數據，以支持比較或多階段學習。該數據集涵蓋2000年至2024年，具有\SI{0.1}{\degree}$\times$\SI{0.1}{\degree}的空間解析度和每週的時間解析度，覆蓋整個全球的海表，並有超過950萬對剖面插值至50個標準化深度層。我們提供了一個可配置的系統，以將全球劃分為相等大小的空間區塊。4D多變量結構、高解析度、長時間範圍和極度稀疏的次表面觀測（每個深度層約0.01\%）使得\textsc{OceanDepths}成為新型AI方法的挑戰性測試平台。我們以簡單的基線模型演示次表面狀態重建作為示例任務，但也預見\textsc{OceanDepths}將支持基於觀測的預測方法和其他相關任務的開發。\added{可在以下網址獲得：https://huggingface.co/datasets/ESA-philab/OceanDepths.}
